user.title: VATSIM ATC Tracker
user.description: Enter the VATSIM CID of the pilot to follow. No VATSIM login or API key is used.

abort.already_configured: This CID is already set up.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.description: All optional. Paths are as Home Assistant sees them, for example /config/vatsim/navdata.

data.simaware_boundaries_path: SimAware TRACON boundaries file or folder
data.metar_fallback: Show the METAR when an airport has no ATIS

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Where flight alerts and problem reports go. Which alerts are on, and which speakers, are switches on the VATSIM Tracker device. Its Test alert button sends one through everything set here.

data.mute_gate_entity: Hold speech while this is on
data.push_repairs: Also push when a repair is raised

data_description.notify_targets: Notify actions and notify entities found on this system. The sidebar notice and the phone app actions (their names contain mobile_app) replace an earlier notice about the same problem; the others get a new one each time.
data_description.speakers: Each one gets a switch on the device, so you can choose rooms without coming back here.
data_description.tts_entity: Needed if any speaker is chosen.
data_description.mute_gate_entity: Optional. Speech plays only while this entity reads off. Pushes still go, and say that speech was held.
data_description.push_repairs: Sent whatever the alert mode is, so switching alerts off never hides a fault.

error.path_not_found: Home Assistant cannot see that path.
error.tts_needed: Choose a text-to-speech engine, or remove the speakers.

feed_unreachable.title: VATSIM feed has not been reachable since the tracker started
feed_unreachable.description:
The tracker has not had one usable download of the VATSIM data feed since it started, and has been trying for at least 10 minutes. Until it does, nothing shows as connected and no alert can fire.

Check that Home Assistant can reach the internet (the feed is at data.vatsim.net). The exact error is under Settings > System > Logs, search for vatsim_atc.

This clears by itself after the first successful download.

feed_stale.title: VATSIM feed is not updating
feed_stale.description:
The tracker's last successful download of the VATSIM data feed is too old: more than 3 minutes while you are connected to VATSIM, or more than 15 minutes otherwise. Position, coverage and alerts are frozen at the last good data.

Check Home Assistant's internet connection, and whether VATSIM itself is having an outage. The exact error is under Settings > System > Logs, search for vatsim_atc.

This clears by itself when downloads work again.

tracker_stalled.title: VATSIM tracker has stopped
tracker_stalled.description:
The tracker has not completed a check of its own health for more than 5 minutes. It has stopped, or it can no longer report its state, so the VATSIM entities may be frozen or out of date.

Reload the integration (Settings > Devices & services > VATSIM ATC Tracker > three-dot menu > Reload). If it happens again, please report it with the log lines for vatsim_atc from Settings > System > Logs.

This clears by itself when the tracker is working again.

processing_error.title: VATSIM tracker cannot process the feed
processing_error.description:
The feed downloads, but the tracker has failed to process it for at least 5 minutes. Entities are not being updated.

This is a fault in the integration, not in your setup. Please report it with the traceback for vatsim_atc from Settings > System > Logs.

This clears by itself when processing works again.

boundaries_not_loaded.title: VATSIM sector boundaries are not loaded
boundaries_not_loaded.description:
The tracker has no usable sector boundaries, so ATC coverage reads as uncontrolled and the coverage and lookahead alerts cannot fire. It retries every 5 minutes. This is reported 5 minutes after a load fails, or after 30 minutes if a load is still running.

Last error: {error}

The boundaries come from the VAT-Spy Client Data Update Project on GitHub. Check that Home Assistant can reach raw.githubusercontent.com.

This clears by itself when a download succeeds.

navdata_not_loaded.title: VATSIM navigation data did not load
navdata_not_loaded.description:
A navigation data folder is set, but the last load failed, was incomplete, or has not finished after 30 minutes (status: {status}). The filed route line may be missing, incomplete or drawn from older data.

Last error: {error}

Check the folder under the integration's Configure button. It needs the X-Plane 12 files earth_fix.dat, earth_nav.dat, earth_awy.dat and earth_aptmeta.dat, and the path must be as Home Assistant sees it, for example /config/vatsim/navdata.

This clears by itself when the data loads; changed files are noticed within the hour.

navdata_expired.title: VATSIM navigation data has expired
navdata_expired.description:
The navigation data in use is AIRAC cycle {cycle}. Its last day was {valid_until} (UTC). The route line may use fixes or airways that have since changed.

Update the files in the navigation data folder when you have the newer cycle. The integration notices changed files within the hour.

This clears by itself when newer data loads.

metar_failing.title: VATSIM METAR lookups are failing
metar_failing.description:
The destination has no ATIS, so the tracker asked for a METAR, and for at least 15 minutes the lookups have ended in an error: one source (VATSIM or aviationweather.gov) failed and the other had no report or failed too. The ATIS card shows no weather meanwhile.

Last error: {error}

Check Home Assistant's internet connection. The exact error is under Settings > System > Logs, search for vatsim_atc.

This clears by itself when a lookup works, or when no METAR is wanted any more.

position_not_restored.title: VATSIM saved aircraft position could not be read

mute_gate_unavailable.title: VATSIM speech is held: the hold entity is unavailable
mute_gate_unavailable.description:
Speech is set to play only while {entity} reads off. It has read {state} for at least 15 minutes, so every spoken VATSIM alert is being held. Pushes are still sent.

Fix that entity, or choose a different one (or none) under the integration's Configure button > Alerts.

This clears by itself when the entity reads on or off again.

alert_delivery_failed.title: A VATSIM alert could not be delivered
alert_delivery_failed.description:
The last push or spoken alert failed:

{error}

Check the targets under the integration's Configure button > Alerts: a phone that was renamed, a speaker that is offline or a text-to-speech engine that was removed are the usual causes. Then press Test alert on the VATSIM Tracker device.

This clears by itself the next time an alert or a test is delivered.
